investigations.name: GEW Wilhelmshaven GmbH
investigations.evidenceSummary: Current GEW first-party page closes the operator scope at five public charging locations and states all GEW stations are operated with ChargePoint; direct card payment (girocard/Mastercard/Visa) and ChargePoint app are supported. Fresh Mobilithek/Eco-Movement surfaces expose concrete ChargePoint EVSEs at 0.44 EUR/kWh with no start/blocking fee on sampled sites, but another current direct-payment surface reports 0.52 EUR/kWh. 0.44*1.19=0.5236 suggests net-vs-gross VAT presentation, but this is not inferred canonically.
investigations.exactGap: Need an authoritative current gross anonymous_ad_hoc tariff/checkout or machine-readable ChargePoint/Mobilithek field that explicitly resolves whether 0.44 EUR/kWh is net and 0.52 EUR/kWh gross across all five GEW public locations; do not promote before that.

priorityTop5.status: parked after two distinct evidence-led passes

nextSafeAction: Continue ChargePoint/Mobilithek-EcoMovement on another bounded partial; park GEW unless a new authoritative gross anonymous-ad-hoc price path appears. Then move to m8mit. No production merge.
